title: Linear spaces in Hessian loci of cubic hypersurfaces
summary: In this paper we will study the Hessian hypersurface associated with a smooth cubic. We prove that the existence of a Hessian locus, associated with a smooth cubic form f, of dimension bigger then the expected one, forces the cubic f to be of Thom-Sebastiani type. Moreover, we will analyze the existence of some projective linear spaces in such Hessian loci and their nature in terms of the Hessian matrix.
